DEAR PARENTS AND CARERS
I would like to welcome you to New Ash Green Primary School. Thank you for visiting our website. You will find information on all aspects of our school life and its community. The combination of our vibrant and exciting passion for education with our calm and nurturing environment makes our school a great place for all to learn.
New Ash Green Primary is set in a semi-rural village location. We have extensive grounds, including an ancient orchard and woodland walks, three playgrounds and a sports field, all of which enhance our children’s learning experience.
We believe that every child should exceed in our school, with their achievements and milestones being recognised and celebrated amongst a caring family environment where home and school work together in partnership. With this ethos underlying our community, we firmly believe that ‘Together Everyone Achieves More’.
We are very proud of our Ofsted Report stating, “every pupil receives the best education possible”. Our school was judged to be ‘Good’ with the report highlighting so many areas of strength; notably the high quality of literacy across the school and the quality of teaching of phonics and reading in Early Years and Key Stage 1.
I do hope you take time to view our website and if you would like to come and see the school in action, please contact us via telephone 01474 873858 or email us at office@new-ash.kent.sch.uk
Mrs C.A.Cain, Executive Headteacher
The school will provide a paper copy of the information on our website free of charge if required.

Parent Teacher Association (PTA)
A Big Thank you for your support.
We would like to thank our parents and carers for their kind generosity last term for supporting our PTA in raising £229.50 for the Non-Uniform Day held on the last day of Term 2, as well as a fantastic £761.60 from funds raised by all the Presents for Parents before Christmas.
A big thank you to our PTA.
Without the support of our PTA and the generosity of our parents and carer, the school would not be able to benefit from all of the wonderful fundraising events which usually take place throughout the year. Despite the unusual times we have all experienced this year, we are delighted to announce that the PTA were still able to donate a fabulous £1,500 for the provision of new library books for all the children at the school to enjoy, as you can see below!
We have great pleasure in announcing the New Chair of the PTA, Ms Maile who has taken over the role from Mrs Airlie and Mrs Gaydon who has taken on the role as Treasurer.
We would also like to thank Mrs Airlie for all of her invaluable support and hard work over the years as the Chair of the PTA.
If any parents or carers wish to join the PTA to help out with any school events, please do get in contact via nagpta@outlook.com
Click here to find out more about joining the PTA
New Ash Green Primary School has an energetic friendly and hard-working PTA which organises fund-raising events throughout the school year. We understand that there are many pressures on time and money, so in recent years the PTA has concentrated on regular events that are a mix of fun times for the children and easy money-making ventures, such as the recent successful recycling schemes.
The PTA seeks to raise funds to benefit the children in school. There are some events which the PTA pays for in total on a regular basis such as visits into school for all children from KIC Theatre, a visiting pantomime for all children to enjoy at Christmas and the funding of gifts and the disco for year 6 leavers. The PTA also renewed sports kit last year for our teams and have helped the choir.
Other events are put on by the PTA working with the staff for everyone to enjoy. There are fairs at Christmas and in the summer, cake sales and non-uniform days. There have been successful and popular Pamper evenings for ladies as well as entertaining Quiz nights and a circus, which the PTA would hope to repeat in the future.
Second Hand Uniform
Jayne Mcarthy is now the lady who deals with second hand uniform. If you have any items to donate or would like to purchase any items please contact Jayne via the PTA email above. Thank you for your support.
We are all parents of children at New Ash Green who give up their time and energy to organise the events we put on. Some of them are very time consuming so new people and willing helpers are always welcome. The PTA is affiliated to the NCPTA (National Council of Parent Teacher Associations) and abide by their constitution. This means there must be an AGM, Chair and Treasurer with minutes kept. There should also be teacher representatives. A great strength of New Ash Green PTA is that there is great teamwork and that we organise everything ourselves. A lot of PTA’s now buy events in at great expense. Our aim is to keep costs as low as possible.
September 2026

Elf Fest
On Thursday 4th December, our Year 6 Sports Leaders ran an ‘Elf Fest’ event for the whole school in the Roundwood Hall. Ten children per class were selected in Years 1 to 5 to take part in the festive activities. Some activities were decoration dash and feed the reindeer. The morning was a success! It was organised and delivered brilliantly by our Sports Leaders. Well done to everyone who took part and showcasing super teamwork skills. It was a fun-packed morning full of Christmas cheer! The Sports Leaders are looking forward to the next event in term 3.
Tournament at Princes Park
On Wednesday 8th October, 10 children from Year 3 & 4 played in a tournament at Princes Park, Dartford. The group stages started with matches against: Sutton-at-Hone, Hextable, Wentworth, Manor and Gateway. The team played brilliantly together, with super goals from Jesse (B1), who was also selected by the referee as player of the day from our group. Well done team Year 3 & 4!
Cooke Shield tournament
On Saturday 4th October, boys from Year 5 & 6 took part in the Cooke Shield tournament at Riverview Primary School. The boys played four games: Holy Trinity, Meopham, St John’s and Riverview. The team played brilliantly together, winning three matches and drawing one. Well done to Bill (H4), Aaron and Jax (H2) for their brilliant goals. The team placed first in their group overall, progressing to the semi-final and then the finals against Painters Ash School. Unfortunately, a goal for Painters Ash in the last second made us runners up for this tournament. Well done boys, you are amazing and have made New Ash Green so proud.
Princes Park tournament
On Monday 22nd September, nine girls from Year 5&6 took part in a tournament at Princes Park in Dartford. The girls played brilliantly together, playing matches against Bean Primary, Sutton-at-Hone and Hextable. This tournament marked the first football tournament of the new school year. Well done girls- what a super team you are.
County Finals Yr 5&6 Boys
On Thursday 13th February, our Year 5 & 6 boys football team played in the County Finals at Thamesmead Sporting Ground. This was an amazing opportunity won by our team after their success in the Gravesham tournament back in October. After a tough qualifying round, and drawing every match 0-0, our team unfortunately did not qualify for the semi-finals. Well done to our brilliant team once again for outstanding team work and determination.
Gravesham Schools league Yr 5&6 Boys
On Wednesday 12th February, our Year 5 & 6 boys football team played Shears Green Junior School in the Gravesham Schools league. After a brilliant match, the final score was 3-0 to Shears Green. Our team played outstandingly well, a huge well done.
Dartford Schools Cup – girls
On Monday 25th November, our Year 5 and 6 girls football team played in a Dartford Schools Cup Match against Dartford Bridge Academy. The girls played brilliantly against a tough team. Unfortunately, losing 3-0 at the final whistle. Well done to our amazing girls team and a special mention to Emily B in B3 for volunteering to play in goal for the match!
Dartford Schools Cup – boys
On Monday 18th November, our Year 5 and 6 boys football team played in a Dartford Schools Cup Match against Dartford Bridge Academy. Our team played brilliantly once again, winning the game with an outstanding 4-0 final score. Congratulations to Eddie and Freddie for scoring fantastic goals, and a huge well done to Archie for scoring two brilliant goals. Well done to our amazing boys team, who will now advance to the next round of the competition.
Cross country
On Friday 8th November our Year 5 and 6 cross country team attended the Brooks & Barrett Cross Country Competition at Cobham Hall School. Our amazing runners tackled a tricky course over grass, woodland and gravel. Our girls team ran 1.7km and the boys ran 2.3km. Well done to all of our brilliant runners, who showed amazing resilience throughout.
Football tournament
On Saturday 12th October our Year 5 and6 boys football team attended a football tournament at Riverview Junior School. Our amazing team successfully progressed all the way to the final without conceding a single goal! After a tough final our fantastic team won 2-0, advancing on to play to win a place at the county finals for Gravesham in February.
